research_question: Can a deterministic, query-balanced, cutoff-aware rank-16 int8 residual sidecar recover candidate-level ranking loss from a byte-identical 1M IVF-PQ index, and does its retrieval-aware basis improve over an ordinary storage-matched residual-PCA sidecar?
scope: outcome-informed MS MARCO 1M method development on oracle_design only; no future holdout, independent confirmation, official MS MARCO claim, full-corpus QAT, query-adapter rescue, index mutation, or paper-success claim

paper_positioning.primary_problem: lightweight post-hoc correction of quantization-induced retrieval degradation in an already deployed frozen IVF-PQ index
paper_positioning.primary_method: one symmetric orthonormal residual subspace plus rank-16 int8 per-document coefficients
not_claimed: global storage optimality when rebuilding is allowed
recovery of documents outside the probed candidate pool
explicit non-relevance for documents absent from positive qrels
general superiority over residual PCA before a locked comparison passes

claim_tiers.algorithm: RARS improves both the frozen M32 base and a storage-matched PCA sidecar under a locked comparison
claim_tiers.generic_sidecar: a compact residual sidecar improves the frozen M32 base, while RARS-over-PCA remains unestablished
claim_tiers.stop: the revised sidecar does not meet the preregistered development evidence floor

prior_negative_results_must_remain_discl: TREC DL 2019 RARS-versus-PCA primary hypothesis unsupported

data_policy.dataset: deterministic qrels-preserving 1M MS MARCO passage development corpus

cross_validation.fold_rule: inherit exact rars_v3_fold_v1 SHA-256 fold assignment

data_policy.challenger_semantics: candidate absent from positive qrels; unjudged, not an explicit non-relevant

forbidden_roles.oracle_audit: historically opened development audit; forbidden in v8 fitting, selection, and decision
forbidden_roles.future_method_holdout: must remain identity-only; no candidates, labels, qrels rows, or metrics may be materialized or opened

basis_constraints.initialization: deterministic uncentred PCA on qrels-free development candidate residuals
basis_constraints.column_orientation: largest-absolute element in each column is non-negative

int8_quantization.scale: one max-absolute FP32 scale per sidecar dimension divided by 127

pair_mining.promotion: known positive outside Base-PQ Top-10 but within Top-40 versus an unjudged Base-PQ Top-10 challenger, admitted only when same-route FP32 ranks the positive higher
pair_mining.protection: known positive in Base-PQ Top-10 versus an unjudged Base-PQ rank 11-26 challenger, admitted only when same-route FP32 ranks the positive higher
pair_mining.query_balancing: each represented query receives equal total mass within a role; role masses are fixed and renormalized only if a role is absent

basis_optimization.objective: query-balanced smooth-L1 error between predicted and exact pairwise residual margins plus PCA subspace-anchor penalty

comparators.frozen_base: the exact M32 nprobe16 IVF-PQ scores and candidates
comparators.storage_matched_pca: same rank16 int8 payload, alpha 0.75, Top-40 correction, scale rule, candidate pool, and scorer; only the basis objective differs
comparators.same_candidate_exact: FP32 exact scoring of the same frozen candidate pool; non-deployable oracle
comparators.zero_document_byte_query_adapter: closed V7 result, diagnostic only and not rerun
comparators.increased_nprobe: routing-cost baseline reserved for locked evaluation
comparators.m48_rebuild: same 48 representation bytes per document but requires a rebuilt index; limitation baseline reserved for locked evaluation

development_metrics.multiple_comparison_policy: RARS-vs-Base is primary; RARS-vs-PCA is the claim-tier comparison; all other metrics are secondary

complete_artifact_bytes_must_include: lookup or external document IDs when required

prohibited_actions: opening or materializing future_method_holdout candidates, labels, qrels rows, or metrics
using oracle_audit, outer-validation, clean-test, TREC, NQ, or FiQA outcomes to fit or select v8
calling unjudged challengers explicit non-relevant documents
changing alpha, rank, Top-B, loss weights, thresholds, or comparator settings after the first v8 OOF metric
updating the encoder, original document embeddings, IVF centroids, lists, PQ codebooks, or PQ codes
claiming RARS superiority when only the generic-sidecar tier passes
claiming independent confirmation from the 803-query future method role
hiding the stronger same-storage M48 rebuild baseline
reporting FP32 sidecar development metrics as deployable int8 results
